segments.title: A new download leaves the page alone
segments.body: Three download links on one page, clicked one after another. nightly.2 opened the Downloads panel on every new download, and the next click only closed it, so the second file never started. Now the panel stays shut and every click downloads.

segments.title: Dragging the floating sidebar's edge resizes it
segments.body: Tabs hidden: the sidebar peeks from the left edge, then its edge gets dragged. nightly.2 dropped the sidebar as soon as the pointer left it; now the drag holds it open and resizes it.

segments.title: The hidden sidebar is calmer at the edge
segments.body: The pointer creeps to the left edge, drifts past the open sidebar, then comes back. nightly.2 opened it about 5 pt from the edge and shut it the moment the pointer slipped off. Now it opens in the last 3 pt, stays up to 40 pt past the panel, and closes 200 ms after you leave.

segments.title: Hidden tabs can open from the shortcut only
segments.body: With the new Reveal hidden tabs on hover setting off, brushing the left edge does nothing and ⌘S still shows the tabs. nightly.2 had no way to stop the edge from opening them.

segments.title: Larger, higher-contrast tab text
segments.body: The same sidebar with the new sidebar text size set to Larger and contrast to High. nightly.2 had one size, in light grey.

segments.title: The Playing now card opens at once
segments.body: The pointer onto the sidebar's media card, slowed down. nightly.2 waited about 250 ms, swapped the time for × in one frame, then jumped most of the way open with the controls cut in half. Now it grows smoothly the moment you arrive.

segments.title: A looping video keeps counting
segments.body: A six-second looping clip in another tab, sped up. nightly.2's card got stuck at -0:00 once the clip looped, until a stray update moved it; now the time counts down every loop.

segments.title: Picture in Picture stays under the pointer
segments.body: The mini player dragged into the right edge of the screen and round a loop back to where it started. nightly.2 lost every step the edge held back and ended 163 pt from the pointer. Now the spot you grabbed comes back under it.

segments.title: ⌘S stops at the page's final width
segments.body: ⌘S twice on a page that prints its own width, slowed down. nightly.2's slide overshot, so the page was laid out 4 pt too wide and resized back. Now it stops at its width, settling in about 120 ms.

segments.title: The tab hover menu can be turned off
segments.body: The pointer runs down the tab list. nightly.2 opened an action card over the page for every tab it rested on; with the new Show tab hover menu setting off, it's just the tabs.

segments.title: Reset Pinned Tab is in the right-click menu
segments.body: Right-click a pinned tab that has wandered from its page. nightly.2 had Reset on the hover card and, as Back to Pinned URL, two levels down; now Reset Pinned Tab sits right under Unpin.
